mapper.sql: select a.id, a.stock_id, a.fail_count, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, a.del_flag from t_stock_recheck a
mapper.select:
select a.id, a.stock_id, a.fail_count, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, b.material_id , b.location_id , b.count , b.batch_code, m.code as materialCode, m.name as materialName, tu.name as unitName, tl.name as locationName, tr.name as reservoirName from t_stock_recheck a left join t_stock b on a.stock_id = b.id left join t_material m on b.material_id = m.id left join t_unit tu on m.unit_id = tu.id left join t_location tl on b.location_id = tl.id left join t_reservoir tr on tl.reservoir_id = tr.id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = a.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
a.del_flag = '0' and a.stock_id = #{stockId} and a.id = #{id} and a.fail_count = #{failCount} and a.status = #{status} and m.code like concat('%',#{materialCode},'%') and m.name like concat('%',#{materialName},'%') and b.batch_code like concat('%',#{batchCode},'%') and tl.reservoir_id = #{reservoirId}
${params.dataScope} order by a.create_time desc
mapper.delete: update t_stock_recheck set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}
